titulo.estudio: Les panneaux utiles : Repérer les informations

intro: Recognize prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public places. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: À l'entrée du parc, un panneau indique « Ouvert de 8 h à 18 h ».
frases.alumno: At the park entrance, a sign reads «Open from 8 to 18».

frases.estudio: Les chiens doivent rester en laisse près du jardin.
frases.alumno: Dogs must be kept on a lead near the garden.

texto: Recognize prohibitions, obligations and basic services in public places. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: on a sign, the imperative or « interdit » usually expresses a rule; the icon and the place give context. In this passage, «entrée» means «entrance».
